profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer @ Optum | Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert
profile.summary:
•  Principal Software Engineer at Optum with 15+ years of experience building scalable, cloud-native applications across healthcare and enterprise domains.
•  Expert in .NET, SQL, C#, Azure, Kubernetes, Kafka and Microservices, with a strong track record in cloud migrations.
•  Passionate about modernizing applications using Generative AI and LangGraph based AI agent development
•  Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert and Microsoft Certified Professional Developer focused on driving technical excellence and high-performing teams.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead a team of 7 engineers as architect and technical lead, driving Azure cloud migration and .NET modernization initiatives across Optum's healthcare technology portfolio.

•  Architected and led migration of 10 web/SPA applications and 45 microservices/REST APIs to Microsoft Azure (AKS, App Service, SQL MI), achieving cloud-native scalability and high availability.
•  Implemented zero-downtime deployments for all 55 apps using Deployment Slot (App Service) and Rolling Updates (AKS) across the organization.
•  Spearheaded .NET Core to .NET 8 upgrade across all 45 microservices and REST APIs, improving performance and long-term supportability.
•  Engineered a LangGraph-based ReAct AI agent to automate health insurance claim decisions using policy references and medical data, reducing manual review time.
•  Designed and developed HL7 FHIR compliant microservices for exchanging prior authorization and documents using .NET Core 3.1, C#, Apache Kafka, and SQL Server for healthcare data interoperability between UHG, Humana, and Optum systems.
•  Completed SSO integration between UHG and naviHealth platforms, eliminating redundant authentication workflows.
•  Remediated 100+ OWASP security vulnerabilities, significantly improving the application security posture.
Mentored and guided team members in architecture, coding standards (SOLID/DRY/KISS), and best practices; conducted deep-level root cause analysis for production issues.
•  Collaborated directly with business stakeholders to align technical roadmaps, manage risks, and deliver transparent status reporting.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · Microsoft SQL Server · .NET · ASP.NET Core · ASP.NET · C# · Kubernetes · Leading Development Teams · Terraform · Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) · Git · GitHub · GitHub Copilot · Docker · Octopus Products · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Dapr · HL7 Standards · Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) · Atlassian Bamboo · AppDynamics · Grafana · Kibana · Jira · Rally · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · Angular · YAML · Helm Charts · Bash · Powershell · Bitbucket

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•   Design, develop, document, test, and debug new and existing software products (cloud and in-house).
•   Serve as a technical expert on development projects. Participate in full development life cycle including requirements analysis and design. Write technical specifications based on conceptual design and stated business requirements.
•  Support, maintain, and document software functionality.
•  Identify and evaluate new technologies for implementation. Analyze code to find causes of errors and revise programs as needed.
•  Participate in software design meetings and analyze user needs to determine technical requirements.
•  Consult with end-users to prototype, refine, test, and debug programs to meet needs.
•  Contribute to team growth by providing advice, mentoring, and coaching to other engineers with positivity and enthusiasm.
•  Identify opportunities for process improvement and effectively present them to decision-makers.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Azure · C# · SQL · Apache Kafka · Oracle · ASP.NET Core · ASP.NET MVC · Node.js · Dynatrace · TypeScript · JavaScript · Angular

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Served as a senior engineer and technical lead for multiple mission-critical healthcare applications serving DaVita's 4,200+ US clinics.

•  Led iOS app middle-tier team developing microservices integrating Realm Object Server (front-end), Apache Kafka (system bus), and Oracle DB (back-end) to manage patient, physician, and nurse data with offline-capable treatment flow sheets.
•  Designed and delivered a patient scheduling web application with complex workforce metrics (salaried and hourly), drag-and-drop UI, and sandbox features — deployed across all DaVita US clinics.
•  Investigated and resolved complex production issues using Dynatrace APM, Kibana logs, and IntelliTrace, conducting deep root-cause analysis during major incidents.
•  Implemented Code-First Entity Framework models, Repository Pattern, and full unit test suites, achieving high code coverage across all layers.
•  Tuned web application and SQL Server stored procedure performance using advanced profiling tools (Entity Framework Profiler, ANTS Memory Profiler).
•  Developed web applications using MVC, Entity Framework, Knockout.js, jQuery, HTML5, and CSS3.
•  Collaborated with UI designers on wireframes and presented solutions to stakeholders for approval; coordinated onsite and offshore teams for technical debt resolution.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET · Apache Kafka · Kubernetes · Microsoft Azure · C# · Entity Framework · Leading Development Teams · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•  Modernized a legacy ASP.NET 2.0 VB.NET application to ASP.NET MVC 4.0 and SQL Server 2008, improving maintainability and performance for NYC's social services platform.
•  Developed ASSETS — a document retrieval system that fetches .tiff and .pdf files from FileNet based on SSNs, merges them, and uploads to FTP for Social Security transmission.
•  Built a report generation web application for Customized Assistance Service (CAS) documents and an IE toolbar for screenshot-to-PDF uploads to FileNet.
•  Implemented Repository Pattern, Unity IoC Dependency Injection, and Code-First Entity Framework 5.0 data models from scratch.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET Core · ASP.NET MVC · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML5 · Entity Framework · React.js · Bootstrap (Framework)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Designed and built the Clubcard Coupons platform — a multi-channel coupon issuance and redemption system supporting both in-store and e-commerce, with single-use product restriction enforcement.
•  Developed WCF services, web applications, and database objects (stored procedures, functions, indexes); fine-tuned applications to meet a 1-second response time SLA.
•  Created SSIS packages for unissued coupon/voucher reporting and generated MSDN-style documentation for the entire project.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · SQL · WCF · Representational State Transfer (REST) · SSIS · jQuery · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · WiX Toolset · Sandcastle

positions.description:
•  Designed and developed automation test suites for Microsoft AdCenter (pay-per-click advertising platform), covering API and UI automated test cases.
•  Built automation frameworks for Online single-box BVT testing, TRX parser web application, and load/stress test cases.

•  Developed web services, database objects, and client-side scripting; optimized application and SQL Server performance using advanced tuning methods.

projects.title: Tesco Clubcard Coupons
projects.description:
The Clubcard Coupons project covers the creation of a system that alongside development with other systems will allow the user to create single-use coupons that can be redeemed in store and the Grocery Home Shopping dotcom website.

Clubcard Coupons will deliver a secure, flexible and multi-channel solution for coupons that can be issued and redeemed in any channel for single use and it will be restricted for redemption against a product or grouping of products bought in any channel.


1.	WCF Services to Redeem and Unredeem
2.	Customer-E Wallet
3.     Voucher at Till
4.	Performance Testing to comply 2 sec response time
5.	MSI to deploy multiple web services and web application
6.     Clubcard Coupon documentation project using SandCastle

projects.title: Microsoft AdCenter
projects.description:
Microsoft AdCenter offers pay per click advertisements. It lets advertisers to target their ads by restricting their ads to a given set of characteristics and by increasing their bids whenever the ad is seen by a user of a certain characteristics. This allows advertisers to create effective ads and to advertise only on searches which are relevant to their advertisement.

1.	Developed Web Application for TRX parser
2.	Developed Automation Testing Framework
3.	Automated tool for Online Single Box BVT Testing
4.	Automation of test cases
